page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8ae.xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the x86_64 architecture. It features 4 dedicated physical cores utilizing an AMD EPYC 9T34 processor running at a clock speed of 3.4 GHz. The instance is configured with 32.0 GB of RAM, yielding an 8.0 GB memory-to-core ratio. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying on network-attached storage and featuring a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals strong single-core performance, with stress-ng single-core CPU performance ranking in the top 10% and Geekbench single-core scores in the top 25%. However, multi-core scaling is moderate, with stress-ng and Geekbench multi-core scores falling into the average category. The processor supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 vector extensions and cryptographic acceleration. Tradeoffs are evident in multi-threaded decompression, software compilation, and database operations, which perform in the lower 25% tier.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, this instance offers a high memory-to-vCPU density suitable for memory-bound workloads that do not require massive parallel compute scaling or local NVMe storage. It is well-suited for in-memory caching, text processing, and lightweight memory-intensive applications, though it is less optimal for heavy database operations, static web serving, or highly parallelized compilation tasks.
